name: after-effects-mcp
description: Control Adobe After Effects: compositions, layers, keyframes and the render queue.
long_description: Lets Claude work in the After Effects project you have open. It can list and create compositions, add solid, text, shape, null, camera, light and footage layers, set keyframes with easing, and queue or start renders. Install the After Effects MCP panel in After Effects for the fastest, permission-free connection; without it, scripts are run through the operating system.

tools.name: list_compositions
tools.description: List compositions in the open project

tools.name: add_layer
tools.description: Add a solid, text, shape, null, adjustment, camera, light or footage layer

tools.name: set_keyframes
tools.description: Set keyframes on a layer property

tools.name: start_render
tools.description: Render the queue in After Effects or Media Encoder
